company.name: StableBrowse
company.shortDescription: StableBrowse provides browser infrastructure and tools that let AI agents navigate and automate workflows on dynamic websites.
company.description: StableBrowse provides browser infrastructure and tools that let AI agents operate reliably on dynamic websites. The company offers a machine-native browser layer that converts pages, forms, and navigation flows into reusable execution and knowledge graphs, so agents can navigate, extract data, and interact without relying on brittle selectors or raw HTML. Its platform includes managed browser clusters, rotating proxies, and session management combined with APIs that expose structured JSON endpoints tailored to customer workflows. StableBrowse supports use cases such as insurance quoting, healthcare provider lookup and scheduling, mortgage rate comparison and pre-qualification, agentic ecommerce, and creative intelligence data collection. Developers integrate StableBrowse through a playground, SDKs, and custom schema APIs to build and scale browser agents inside authenticated portals and repetitive web workflows.
